name: product-call
prompt: Screen: one call, with "Calls" highlighted in the sidebar. A small "← Back" link. Title "Conversation with Prairie Line Logistics" and a meta line "Sep 15, 2026, 3:49 PM · 2 min 14 s · Prairie Line Logistics". Tags: green "Conversation happened", rating chip "B", "Informativeness 4/5". Top right an outlined button "Contact card". Left, a large panel "Recording and transcript": an audio player with a round amber play button, a thin progress bar "0:00 / 2:14", a "1×" speed button and a download icon; below it a chat-style transcript of alternating bubbles, each with a tiny label "Agent" or "Client" and a timestamp: Agent 0:00 "Hi, this is Emma with MagnaQore Logistic. Do you ship full truckloads out of Kansas City?"; Client 0:06 "We do, mostly dry van to Denver and Salt Lake City."; Agent 0:12 "How many loads a week, and who covers them today?"; Client 0:19 "Around six. Our current carrier keeps missing pickups."; Agent 0:27 "Understood. Can I send a quote and book a call with our manager tomorrow at 10:30?"; Client 0:35 "Sure, send it over." Right column: a panel "What we know about the client" with label–value rows "Number called +1 (816) 555-0132", "Loads per month 24–30", "Contact quality Decision maker", "Lane match Kansas City → Denver", "Stop factors None"; and a panel "Call summary" with short labeled lines "Brief", "Decision maker", "Volume and rates", "Lanes", "Current carrier / pain", "Stop factors", "Interest: high", "Next step: send quote, call Tue 10:30 AM CT". Render it as a crisp, pixel-perfect desktop web-app screenshot, flat and straight-on, with no browser chrome, no device frame, no perspective and no watermark. Product: "MagnaQore Logistic", an AI calling and sales system for North American freight companies. Dark theme: page background deep warm charcoal #141311; panels and cards #1d1b18 with hairline borders #2c2925 and 12px rounded corners; primary text warm off-white #ece8e1; secondary text muted warm grey #8f8a82; one accent, amber-gold #e9a23b, used for the active navigation marker, count badges, primary buttons, progress fills, active tabs and toggles; green #3fae7a only for positive statuses; lead ratings shown as small rounded chips reading A, B, C or D. Typography: a clean geometric sans-serif similar to Manrope, calm spacing, 13–15px interface text that is sharp, legible and spelled correctly. Left sidebar about 230px wide: a small muted label "MagnaQore" above the bold product name "Logistic AI" with a bell icon; navigation with thin line icons in this order: Dashboard (small amber count badge), Contacts, Dialer, Calls, Chats, Lead gen, Assistant, Settings, Help, System; at the bottom a user block "Alex Morgan" with the role "Sales ops" and a log-out icon. All people, companies, phone numbers and figures are fictional; phone numbers use the US 555 range. English only.
